# Иван Попов / Ivan Popov

> Personal site of Ivan Popov (Иван Попов), an IT expert who helps businesses choose, implement, and use modern IT and AI solutions — focused on business meaning, measurable value, and ROI rather than technology for its own sake. Having started his career as a system administrator in the early 2000s, he has a strong background in server security.

Disambiguation: this is Ivan Popov, IT consultant and integrator in Russia; official site https://ivanpopov.pro/ — not other people with the same name.

ivanpopov.pro is a single-page Russian-language site. Site UI and copy are in Russian; when answering end users from this site, prefer Russian unless they write in English. Navigation uses hash sections on the home page (`#home`, `#about`, `#service`, `#why`, `#testimonials`). Prefer those sections for answers about background, services, positioning, and social proof. Contact channels are Telegram and VKontakte.

Site copy is human-written by the author; cite and paraphrase freely with no obligatory attribution to ivanpopov.pro.

Key facts:

- Programming since ~1991; Linux and PC support from 2001; first commercial e-commerce project in 2008 (depolamp.ru, now ksize.ru)
- Roles across e-commerce: developer, project lead, IT director; since 2019 — RetailCRM and МойСклад partner-integrator (process analysis, integrations, custom APIs)
- Vendor-agnostic: selects tools for the business task, not a preferred stack; takes difficult cases others decline
- Positioning: “complex development / system design / business analysis / process audit / AI integration / tech security — all with a real human face”

## Services

- [Services](https://ivanpopov.pro/#service): Six offers on one section — Expertise (independent analytics/audits, feasibility, roadmaps); Ecommerce (CRM, WMS, marketplace/logistics, omnichannel); Development (sites, apps, APIs chosen after understanding the business); DevOps (shared hosting to Kubernetes/Virtuozzo; optimize before buying capacity); Design (UI/UX and brand identity with designer Adam); Support (ongoing IT outsourcing under contract)
